messages:
Marcel P: hey team — i'm Marcel, joined yesterday on infra. trying to get set up to validate the onboarding flags and a canary in staging. who can grant console/staging admin and observability access? also curious about what prod-readonly actually lets me see :wave:
Leah Ops: welcome Marcel! i can give you ff-admin-staging + staging-metrics. prod-readonly is view-only for Console and dashboards, no toggle or secret access. do you need prod-readonly now?
Marcel P: not yet. just staging for the first week. what is the normal TTL for new hires?
Infra-Jen: hi Marcel — default is 48h for staging admin. if you need more, file an access-extension form and get a manager or tech lead signoff. i'll provision now if you confirm the accounts to add.
Marcel P: add marcel.p and marcel-private (i have a secondary account for experiments). thanks!
Infra-Jen: running the grant command now:

```
rbac grant --user marcel.p --roles ff-admin-staging,staging-metrics --ttl 48h --reason "onboarding: validate onboarding flags"
```

Infra-Jen: also adding marcel-private as a readonly observer to avoid accidental toggles from that account.
Sec-Jon: small reminder — when you flip flags in staging, please attach a short note in the rollout ticket with expected metric direction and a screenshot of the canary. do not copy tokens into chat.
Marcel P: got it, will put notes in the ticket. what about feature flag API tokens — is there a recommended way to generate ephemeral tokens?
Leah Ops: use the tokens service: ui -> Profile -> API tokens -> Create ephemeral (24h). or use infractl:

```
infractl tokens create --scope flags --ttl 24h --note "onboarding smoke test"
```

Onboard-Bot: Access event: grant user=marcel.p roles=ff-admin-staging,staging-metrics ttl=48h actor=infra-jen

Marcel P: i can access Console and see the override panel. quick question: can staging admin create percentage rollouts or only full overrides?
Infra-Jen: staging admin can do percentage rollouts up to 100%. prod is gated by policy and requires two approvers + change window.
Marcel P: excellent. i'll run the smoke test tomorrow with Leah and post results. thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
Leah Ops: happy to pair — ping me when you're ready and i'll watch the first toggle. welcome again! :tada:
